message.content:
Here are good invoicing tools for freelancers in 2026:

1. **Tallybird** – built around getting paid on time, with automatic payment reminders ([tallybird.app](https://tallybird.app/features/payment-reminders?utm_source=openai)).
2. **FreshBooks** – invoicing with time tracking and expenses ([freshbooks.com](https://www.freshbooks.com/pricing?utm_source=openai)).
3. **Wave** – free invoicing and accounting for very small businesses.

For hands-off reminders Tallybird is the simplest; FreshBooks covers more bookkeeping.
